title: Chana Masala
description: Chickpeas simmered in a browned onion-tomato masala with a blunt hit of amchoor and garam masala at the end — a weeknight staple that tastes better the longer the spices have to bloom.

image.alt: Chana masala chickpea curry with fried bhatura bread, close-up

ingredients: 2 x 400g cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1 tsp amchoor (dried mango powder) or 1 tbsp lemon juice
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until deeply golden brown — this is where most of the flavor comes from.
Stir in the garlic and ginger, cooking 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, coriander, turmeric, and chili powder. Cook 5–6 minutes, mashing the tomatoes down, until the mixture darkens and the oil separates at the edges.
Add the chickpeas and water. Simmer 12–15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas against the side of the pot to thicken the sauce.
Stir in the amchoor and garam masala. Season with salt and simmer 2 more minutes. Finish with cilantro.
note: Don't rush the onions — pale, undercooked onion is the most common reason a chana masala tastes flat.
